stories.title: OBD capture -- serialize ObdConnection wrapper + fence orphaned timeout daemons (F-117/A-17, P0)
acceptance: the single serialization lock lives on the ObdConnection WRAPPER (obd_connection.py), NOT lifecycle.py (GAP-1, load-bearing) -- guards EVERY .obd access (connect/query/close/probe); ALL callers acquire it: the lifecycle connect/query daemons, the US-301 heartbeat path, AND the realtime logger's direct reads at logger.py:220 AND 290 (which do NOT route through lifecycle)
fence orphaned timeout daemons: a timed-out connect/query thread is BARRED (ownership/generation token) from touching a connection a later thread owns -- cannot corrupt the owner's serial I/O
preserve the TD-036 no-boot-hang property (bounded connect; boot never hangs) -- must not regress
thread-named instrumentation so the concurrency is observable in logs

real-concurrency test (GAP-1 VC): spin the LOGGER read path concurrently with a superseded/orphaned daemon against the SAME wrapper instance + assert no interleaving -- exercises the cross-layer race, fails pre-fix passes after (NOT a mocked-at-lifecycle test)
Rule-10 bound HERE (GAP-3/A-11): US-441 does NOT close until the connection-threading-model section of specs/architecture.md is updated in-sprint
acceptance drill (car): a live sustained-capture drive shows realtime_data rows accumulating steadily (not 0, not first-read-then-disconnect)
ruff check + mypy (strict) pass on modified files

stories.title: idle-poll cold-boot RPM-mask fix (BL-016, Option B; 2nd capture fix; deps US-441)
acceptance: Atlas-ruled Option B: un-mask RPM past python-obd's dark-ECU support cache via a force read, SCOPED to known-mandatory Mode-01 PIDs (RPM minimum) -- NEVER blanket (blanket re-exposes the 0x42/0x0B/0x15 garbage US-199 skips); RPM is mandatory Mode-01 = known-supported, so forcing corrects a false-negative not an unsupported PID

applied to BOTH the escalation probe AND the ongoing poll -- a connection-scoped 'engine-confirmed -> force mandatory PIDs' latch set on the escalation edge (core.py:1205), cleared on drive_end (1264) + disconnect (drive_start fires only on RPM sustained>threshold across ticks at detector.py:660-667 -> the ongoing poll must un-mask, not just the probe)

US-388 non-regression: touches ONLY the read path (force flag) -- NOT evaluateTimeouts/_maybeCloseOnDeadline/_openDriveId/NULL-latch/_startDrive; drive_start fires through the unchanged RPM-sustained machine
deps US-441 (A-17 race fixed first); live-Pi bench confirm folds into the A-9 re-gate: after engine-on in cold-boot-key-OFF seq, one forced 010C returns real RPM + drive_start row + non-NULL RPM
ruff check + mypy (strict) pass on modified files
